name: Basic Kayaking Course
benefit: The beneficiary will receive the training in basic kayaking.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be able to swim 100 meters within 3 minutes. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically fit. 1. The applicant must have prior training in life-saving techniques and water sports operations from a recognized institute. > The total number of 15 beneficiaries will be selected.
